maintenance_led.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes to first-time and move-up buyers; revenue comes from new home sales, not repairs.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are sold to private consumers, paid by buyers' savings and mortgages, with KBHS Home Loans as an affiliate.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes in its own communities across states, with only occasional land or company purchases.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers can choose another homebuilder before purchase; it is a one-time purchase with no ongoing switching costs.
